CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_column_to_now()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at := now();
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
details.definition: CREATE TRIGGER booking_payments_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.booking_payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_column_to_now()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purchases_fill_ids()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_post_id uuid;
  v_product_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- If post_id is missing but product_id is present, derive post_id
  IF NEW.post_id IS NULL AND NEW.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(pr.post_id, p.id)
      INTO v_post_id
    FROM public.products pr
    LEFT JOIN public.posts p
      ON p.product_id = pr.product_id
    WHERE pr.product_id = NEW.product_id
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_post_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      NEW.post_id := v_post_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- If product_id is missing but post_id is present, derive product_id
  IF NEW.product_id IS NULL AND NEW.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(p.product_id, pr.product_id)
      INTO v_product_id
    FROM public.posts p
    LEFT JOIN public.products pr
      ON pr.post_id = NEW.post_id OR pr.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.id = NEW.post_id
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      NEW.product_id := v_product_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- If post_id is still null, give a clear error (better than generic NOT NULL)
  IF NEW.post_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'purchases.post_id is required; could not derive from product_id % (link products.post_id or posts.product_id)',
      NEW.product_id
      USING ERRCODE = '23502';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$
details.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_purchases_fill_ids BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.purchases FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION purchases_fill_ids()
